findings.F1: In the choppy market (folds B, C), the 3-day excess return falls only in the two lowest quintiles of the 30-day return: -0.33 of a usual move in the lowest (t -2.10, 104 cases, 60 days) and -0.15 in the second (t -1.90, 104 cases). The middle and upper quintiles sit near 0 (-0.003, -0.026, -0.006, all |t| < 0.4). So the tested effect lives in the deepest month-long falls, and the gradient inside the fall side is weak (slope t 1.06 at 3 days, 272 cases).
findings.F2: Among choppy bars with a 30-day fall, the agitated ones carry the effect. Their 3-day excess is -0.48 of a usual move (t -2.54, 71 cases), against -0.09 for the calm ones (t -1.27, 201 cases). Over 7 days it is -0.59 (t -2.09, 34 cases) against -0.18 (t -1.94, 77 cases). The map holds no strategy in the choppy agitated short cell (0).
findings.F3: The choppy 30-day-fall effect grows with the horizon. The excess is -0.11 of a usual move at 1 day (t -1.81, 809 cases), -0.19 at 3 days (t -2.50, 272 cases) and -0.31 at 7 days (t -2.64, 111 cases). At 7 days the graded slope on calm bars is +0.26 (t 2.59, 77 cases), the first horizon where the depth of the fall orders the move.
findings.F4: The brief's mirror does not appear on the rise side. Choppy bars with a 30-day rise show a 3-day excess of -0.02 (t -0.33, 248 cases) and a 7-day excess of +0.09 (t 0.70, 104 cases), and the top 30-day quintile gives -0.006 (t -0.07).
findings.F5: The book's gain rests on one window and a few years. Its mean daily return is +0.108 % in w16 (daily standard deviation 1.15 %), against negative means in 7 of the 12 explored windows (w8 -0.025 %, w10 -0.025 %, w17 -0.032 %). The mean gain on active bars is +0.14 % in 2020 and -0.01 % in 2021 (472 bars). This matches the failed one-window-left-out Sharpe (-0.072).

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, the larger a coin's 30-day fall below zero (its close under its close of 30 days earlier), the more it falls over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A deeper month-long fall is a stronger reason to short for a few days when a trendless coin is also swinging more than usual, and a weak one when it is calm.
ideas.name: choppy agitated month fall

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 30-day fall below zero, the more it falls over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: In a trendless market, a deeper month-long fall is a reason to hold a short for a week rather than three days, so the move it captures covers a trade's cost.
ideas.name: choppy month fall week
